title: Calibration retention simulator and artifact access flows
creator: Asha Menon
description: Scope: Add a retention policy simulator and formalize artifact access flows for calibration jobs (FP8/INT8 quant profiles, calibration traces, and accuracy validation reports) surfaced in the Redwood Console. The feature will: 1) allow admins to define tenant-scoped retention tiers (default, extended, archival) with TTLs and soft-delete grace windows; 2) simulate long-running retention/GC behavior and projected storage/cost impact for a given workload mix; 3) introduce explicit artifact roles (Calibration Viewer, Artifact Steward, Artifact Admin) and UI workflows for promotion, snapshotting, and immutable export; 4) ensure artifacts produced by calibration runs can be encrypted with tenant KMS keys and audited at access time.
acceptance_criteria: Console UI exposes retention tiers and per-tenant defaults with editable TTLs and grace windows
Simulator accepts historical run metadata CSV and returns a 12-month projection for artifact volume and cost (broken down by artifact type)
RBAC mapping exists and is enforced: Calibration Viewer (view-only), Artifact Steward (promote/export), Artifact Admin (modify retention/policy)
Soft-delete semantics implemented: artifacts move to quarantined storage for grace window before irreversible deletion; UI shows quarantined items
Calibration artifacts can be encrypted with tenant-managed KMS and access requests are logged to audit stream
Accuracy validation gating: when a promoted quant profile shows regression > configured threshold, promotion is blocked and a rollback path is surfaced
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (AB test): enable retention simulator and read-only RBAC for 20 pilot tenants. Phase 2: enable promotion flows and soft-delete for customers opt-in. Phase 3: default enablement + migration tool for existing artifacts. Monitoring: retention-ttl-matches, artifact-gc-rate, simulator-forecast-accuracy dashboards
mitigations: Risk: accidental mass deletion from misconfigured TTLs. Mitigation: require Artifact Admin approval + two-step confirmation UI + 48h soft-delete quarantine
Risk: high-sensitivity tenants needing longer retention. Mitigation: per-tenant overrides and vaulting to cold storage on-demand
Risk: simulator inaccuracies. Mitigation: maintain reconciliation job that compares predicted vs actual monthly and surfaces calibration alerts
